about.title: At the Roots of Universal African Wisdom
about.subtitle: AWS : Africa World Saving was born from a deep conviction: African ancestral spirituality is a beacon of light, harmony, and renewal for the modern world.
about.originsText: Founded in Cotonou, Benin—a sacred cradle of ancient initiations, ancestral Fa divination, and reverence for natural elements—Africa World Saving bridges seekers of truth with authentic keepers of sacred wisdom. For too long, African traditions have been misunderstood or commercialized dishonestly. Our mission is to restore the honor, transparency, and purity of these millennia-old teachings.
about.missionText: To offer every soul, regardless of geographical location, a safe and confidential sanctuary to release doubts, receive enlightened spiritual direction, and reconnect with ancestral strength.
about.v1Desc: Rituals and spiritual counsel passed down through traditional lineages with strict adherence to cosmic balance.
about.v2Desc: No guarantees of instant wealth or forced love bonds. We cultivate truth, self-empowerment, and free will.
about.v3Desc: Our digital platform protects your anonymity and personal information to the highest standards (Benin APDP & European GDPR).
about.v4Desc: Fair pricing, free discovery sessions, and local Mobile Money integration so no seeker is barred from guidance.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know regarding consultation procedures, our ethical charter, and payment security.
faq.q1: What sets Africa World Saving apart from other spiritual services?
faq.a1: We strictly adhere to an uncompromising ethical code: zero superstition exploitation, zero false promises of overnight fortune or forced romantic returns. Our guides are rigorously initiated into authentic traditions of Benin and Africa, vetted by our elders council.
faq.q2: How does a remote spiritual session take place?
faq.a2: Upon booking, you receive access to our private encrypted sanctuary. At your scheduled hour, connect via chat, audio call, or video call. Everything runs smoothly in your browser, even on modest smartphones with 3G/4G networks.
faq.a3: We accept major African Mobile Money providers via Chariow: MTN Mobile Money, Moov Money, Orange Money, Wave, as well as Visa and Mastercard for the international diaspora.
faq.q4: Does the free discovery consultation obligate me to make a purchase?
faq.a4: No. The 15-minute discovery consultation is free for new members with no payment obligation. You remain entirely free to continue or stop at any time.
faq.q5: Are my personal confessions and session notes kept confidential?
faq.a5: Yes. All exchanges are encrypted. Africa World Saving strictly complies with the Benin Personal Data Protection Authority (APDP) and the European GDPR for international users.
